root_text:
Protect yourself from #HMPV:

•Wash hands often
•Avoid close contact with sick people
•Cover coughs/sneezes
•Disinfect surfaces
•Stay home if sick

 Prevent the spread of respiratory infections. Stay safe! #HealthTips"
